title: Lead Robotics Engineer - Mobility Robots
description:
**Job Overview**
The role is for a Lead Robotics Engineer as part of the engineering team, responsible for both the technical direction and the people leadership of a team of robotics engineers. As a lead robotics engineer, you will guide the development of autonomous navigation and mobility functions of robots designed for material handling across different environments, while managing a team of engineers and overseeing multiple projects running in parallel. You shall drive the technical roadmap for the navigation stack, path-planning algorithms, and localization algorithms using various sensors to deal with dynamic environments like warehouses, manufacturing facilities, etc, while mentoring engineers, reviewing designs and code, and ensuring delivery across various ongoing projects. You will lead the team building world-class products designed and manufactured in Pune (India), and shipped worldwide!
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and deploy algorithms for navigation, path planning, and computer vision.
* Conduct research and stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in the field of robotics
* Collaborate with diverse teams to integrate robotic systems.
* Develop a deep understanding of various sensors, including 2D/3D lidars and cameras.
* Optimize algorithms for real-time performance.
* Engage in hands-on tasks related to robotic hardware, such as system setup, calibration, and debugging.
* Test robotic systems in both simulated and real-world scenarios.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of robotics engineers, providing technical guidance, conducting design and code reviews, and supporting their career development.
* Own planning and delivery across multiple concurrent robotics projects, prioritizing work, allocating engineering resources, and tracking progress against timelines.
* Define technical roadmaps and system architecture decisions for navigation, perception, and fleet software, balancing short-term delivery with long-term scalability.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across hardware, product, and business teams to align engineering execution with organizational priorities.
* Drive hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews for the team, and help build a strong bench of robotics talent.
* Establish and uphold engineering best practices across the team, including code quality standards, documentation, and testing rigor.

**Experience And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer science, Electrical engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in the Robotics Industry.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Passion for developing software for world-class robots.
* Excellent C++ programming and software design skills to support high-performance perception.

Experience with Python is a plus.
  
  

* Hands-on experience with SLAM, robot navigation, and behavior planning.
* Hands-on experience with real robots and perception sensors such as cameras, and 2D/3D LIDARs.
* Experience with different communication protocols such as Modbus, CAN bus, UART, etc.
* Experience with ROS1 and/or ROS2.
* Strong sense of curiosity and an eagerness to learn new concepts, technologies, and methodologies.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring a team of engineers, with the ability to give constructive technical feedback and grow team capability.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing effectively across competing deadlines and shifting requirements.
* Comfortable owning decisions on system architecture and technical trade-offs, and communicating them clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.

**Will be reporting to:**
Chief Technology Officer
  
  
**Working with teams based out of:**
India, USA, EU, MEA, Singapore, Japan
  
  
Skills: perception,sensors,robotics

title: GenAI Architect
description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking a highly skilled GenAI Architect to lead the design and implementation of next-generation AI/ML solutions with a strong focus on GenAI Agents, Agentic AI systems, and Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with architectural leadership to build scalable, production-grade AI platforms that deliver tangible business outcomes.
  
  

* Role: GenAI Architect
* Location: Pune
* Experience: Between 5 to 8 Years
* Job Type: Full Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
* Design and develop Agentic AI systems and GenAI-powered applications.
* Define AI technology roadmaps aligned with business priorities and innovation goals.
* Build scalable architectures integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with enterprise systems and domain-specific knowledge sources.
* Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Guide development teams in AI engineering best practices, solution design, and deployment strategies.
* Evaluate emerging GenAI, Agent Frameworks, LLM orchestration platforms, and AI tooling.
* Design AI application workflows, orchestration pipelines, and autonomous agent ecosystems.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify AI use cases and business value opportunities.
* Establish AI governance, security, scalability, and operational best practices.
* Support proof-of-concept development and drive production adoption of AI solutions.
* Mentor engineers, AI developers, and technical teams.
* Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and cloud AI services.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5-8 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or advanced software engineering.
* Strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and autonomous AI agents.
* Deep understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and enterprise AI applications.
* Hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-powered applications.
* Strong proficiency in Python 3.x and AI application development.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex.
* Expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Experience integrating vector databases and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Strong understanding of AI orchestration, prompting strategies, and agent workflows.
* Experience designing scalable and secure AI architectures.
* Familiarity with machine learning pipelines and model lifecycle management.
* Strong analytical, architectural, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
  
  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.

title: IT Quality Senior Manager -Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description:**

As a SDET QA Manager, you will be a visionary and strategic leader responsible for defining and executing the long-term Quality Assurance strategy across multiple product lines or an entire enterprise division. This role demands a strong techno-functional leader who can drive significant improvements in software quality, accelerate delivery, and foster a culture of engineering excellence through advanced SDET practices, innovative automation solutions, and the strategic adoption of AI tools. You will lead and scale high-performing QA teams, champion best practices, and influence technology decisions at a senior level. Extensive experience within the Capital Markets domain is a critical requirement for this role.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Vision & Leadership:**

* Define and articulate the overarching QA vision and strategy, aligning it with business objectives and technological advancements.

* Provide thought leadership in quality engineering, promoting a shift-left approach and continuous quality embedded throughout the SDLC.

* Drive the adoption of cutting-edge testing methodologies, tools, and frameworks to enhance product quality and delivery speed.

* Influence and shape product strategy from a quality perspective, ensuring robust, scalable, and secure solutions.

* Leverage deep Capital Markets domain knowledge to inform QA strategy, risk assessment, and compliance adherence.

**Advanced Automation & AI Integration:**

* Architect and oversee the implementation of enterprise-level automation frameworks capable of supporting diverse technologies and project types (e.g., microservices, cloud-native, mobile).

* Spearhead initiatives to research, evaluate, and onboard advanced AI/ML tools and techniques to optimize testing processes, predict defects, and improve overall QA efficiency and intelligence.

* Ensure seamless integration of advanced automation into highly mature CI/CD/CT pipelines, driving continuous deployment with confidence.

* Maintain hands-on familiarity with modern automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright) and programming languages (Python, Java, Javascript, Typescript), capable of providing expert guidance and resolving complex technical challenges.

**Organizational Impact & Stakeholder Management:**

* Collaborate extensively with senior leadership across Engineering, Product Management, and Business units to embed quality assurance principles and goals.

* Act as a key liaison for quality-related matters, representing the QA organization in strategic discussions and planning.

* Establish and enforce enterprise-wide quality governance, standards, and metrics, ensuring adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements.

* Communicate complex technical and strategic concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Team & Talent Development:**

* Build, lead, and mentor a distributed team of highly skilled SDETs, QA Engineers, and QA Leads, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

* Develop career paths, succession plans, and professional development programs to attract, retain, and grow top QA talent.

* Drive organizational change and cultivate a mindset of proactive quality assurance across development teams.

**Operational Excellence & Risk Management:**

* Oversee the performance of the QA organization, ensuring efficient resource allocation, budget management, and timely delivery of quality objectives.

* Implement robust risk assessment and mitigation strategies for quality-related issues.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on data analysis, feedback loops, and industry benchmarks.

**Qualifications:**

  
  

* 15+ years of extensive experience in Software Development Engineering in Test (SDET) and senior QA leadership roles, with a proven track record of managing large-scale QA organizations or functions.

* Demonstrated success in defining and implementing transformative QA strategies, resulting in measurable improvements in product quality, time-to-market, and operational efficiency.

* Significant experience in leading the adoption and integration of AI/ML technologies within QA processes.

* Proven hands-on expertise in developing, maintaining, and scaling complex automation frameworks across diverse technological stacks.

* Mandatory extensive experience within the Capital Markets domain, including a deep understanding of financial products, trading lifecycles, regulatory compliance and market data systems.

**Technical Skills:**

* Expert-level proficiency in designing and implementing automation frameworks using tools like Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar.

* Mastery of programming languages with a strong understanding of object-oriented design principles and software architecture.

* Advanced database skills (SQL, NoSQL), including complex query optimization, data migration, and data integrity testing.

* Deep understanding and practical experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices architecture, and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

* Strong command of CI/CD/CT tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) and best practices for integrating automated tests.

* Experience with performance, security, and accessibility testing tools and methodologies.

**Functional Skills:**

* Ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into effective test strategies and cases.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Leadership & Strategic Skills:**

* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and inspire at all organizational levels.

* Proven ability to drive large-scale organizational change and foster innovation in quality engineering.

* Strong business acumen and ability to align technical strategies with organizational goals.

* Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities in complex environments.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  
  

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred
